content: ssh-keygen -s can sign with CA key in PKCS#11 (-D lib, CA identified by public half) or in ssh-agent (-U). OpenSSH source: CA signature key parsed with allow_cert=0 and sshkey_type_is_valid_ca => no cert chaining; any non-cert key type incl. sk keys may be CA. OpenSSH 10.1 added ed25519 PKCS#11 (ssh-keygen -D enumeration broken, fixed 10.2); 10.1 also broke CA signing via agent (fixed 10.2). Go x/crypto/ssh NewSignerFromSigner + Certificate.SignCert accept any crypto.Signer (HSM).
